content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-17|COREMERCH guide to payments]]-what-actually-how-9|Digital Product]] creators in countries like Nigeria and Ghana face substantial barriers in establishing online stores due to payment platform restrictions. Conventional services like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators without viable options to sell their digital products. This guide outlines a step-by-step deployment of a digital store using Supabase as the order database, ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-15|crypto]] payments seamlessly without relying on traditional platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Building a digital store on a solid infrastructure like Supabase ensures that you are not dependent on third-party platforms that can impose restrictions or fees. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you gain full control over your store without the risk of sudden changes in policies or service availability. This architecture is designed for resilience, allowing creators to operate independently and securely, even in regions experiencing financial isolation or currency instability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the necessary components: a GitHub account for hosting your site, access to Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for payment processing. Additionally, you’ll need a Supabase account to manage your order database and optionally, a domain name to enhance your store's branding. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, along with any marketing material you'll use to promote your store once live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using Supabase to manage orders. Create tables for products, orders, and customers to track transactions effectively. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that your store can process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies seamlessly. Test the payment flow to confirm that transactions are processed correctly and that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation. This setup ensures a reliable and efficient order management system that works as promised.
Take full control of your digital storefront without relying on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, it’s time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages site and ensure all links are functioning correctly. Promote your store through social media and other channels to attract customers. Once your first customer makes a purchase, monitor the transaction through the Supabase dashboard to verify that the order is recorded accurately. This step is crucial to ensure your system works flawlessly, providing both you and your customers with confidence in the purchasing process.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider ways to scale your operations. Enhance your product offerings by adding more digital goods or exploring partnerships with other creators. Utilize the analytics available in Supabase to track sales trends and customer behavior, informing your marketing strategy. As you grow, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring your store is fully optimized for performance and security.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use infrastructure tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup circumvents the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors, allowing you to operate efficiently in regions where those services are unavailable.
Deploy your store in hours, not weeks, and start processing payments immediately.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your digital store. 2. Set up a Google Apps Script for backend logic. 3. Register with NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency payments. 4. Create a Supabase account for managing your order database. 5. Prepare your digital products for upload. 6. Publish your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 7. Test the payment processing flow. 8. Promote your store across social media and relevant channels. 9. Monitor initial transactions through Supabase.
Frequently Asked Questions

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase for database management, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination provides a cost-effective and efficient solution without the need for traditional payment processors.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments for a streamlined deployment within 4-6 hours. Stack 02, on the other hand, employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with a comprehensive setup that COREMERCH deploys and tests end-to-end within 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide reliable hosting solutions that integrate well with the necessary backend services for payment processing and order management.
What types of digital products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, software, and more. The infrastructure is designed to deliver these products efficiently, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
How do I ensure my store is secure and reliable?

Security and reliability can be ensured by using well-established platforms like Supabase for data management and NOWPayments for secure payment processing. Regularly monitor your infrastructure and user feedback to maintain a trustworthy environment.
